name: tempo-calendar
description: Connect Claude Code to Tempo Calendar on your Mac to view and change your events and tasks. Requires Tempo for Mac with AI Integration turned on.

tempo_token.title: Tempo token
tempo_token.description: In Tempo, open Settings > AI Integration, click How to Connect next to Claude Code, then click Copy Token Only.

tempo_url.title: Tempo address
tempo_url.description: Keep the default unless you changed the port in Tempo's settings.
